item.title: Portfolio Highlight: Snack Tracker
item.description:
Overview

In this post I will be discussing the SnackTracker project that was worked on in 2017 (my third summer at PointSource). At a high-level, SnackTracker was a fullstack IoT system that incorporated software and hardware into a seamless experience. NOTE this is a very high level look at the project as a whole and I won’t be going into too much detail (I would hate to bore you…). If you love details feel free to email me any questions or requests at timcreasmanwebsite@gmail.com!

item.title: Just One Yes
item.description:
You are a Yes Away from Changing Your Life

It only takes one yes to change your life.

I wanted to take a step back and see where my decisions brought me to today and the importance of taking risks. That being said, this post is NOT me telling you to say yes to everything. Learning to say no is an invaluable skill and making solid promises is even more valuable. But don’t just take my word for it!
